page.content:
Klingon Starfleet officer of the Enterprise-D.

How Worf connects

  • Faction: Enterprise-D crew — Worf is security chief of the Enterprise-D crew.
  • Faction: Klingon Empire — Worf is a Klingon who also serves Starfleet.

What is Worf?

Worf is the Klingon raised among humans who serves as TNG's security chief and carries the Empire's honor onto a Federation bridge.

Key threads lead to Enterprise-D crew and Klingon Empire.
